source_analysis.method: 22.05 kHz mono; HPSS harmonic component; onset detection; 36-bin/octave CQT; up to 5 local spectral pitch hypotheses per onset
source_analysis.coordinate_alignment: 32-bar existing score/form map; bar/beat positions interpolated within verified 8-bar section windows

public_data_policy: Exact candidate-note event list remains private/local and is not committed; public repository stores non-reconstructive counts/status only.
blockers: mixed trio audio does not provide reliable piano/bass separation
automatic multi-pitch CQT peaks are note hypotheses, not ground truth
note offsets, pedal-induced sustain and voicing membership are not yet ground truth
RealChord expected harmony is available as stable song identity but raw chart still requires full structural normalization for beat-level expected-chord join
